krishna.face: Youthful divine adult, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene smile, U-tilak — Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold kundala, no flute, no bow, not a child

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09 lock — even in brahmin guise
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver, Gandiva — never flower garland, never peacock, never Krishna’s pitambar

draupadi.face: Young Panchala princess, luminous noble face, dark eyes — not a second Arjuna, not Krishna
draupadi.hair: Long dark hair with gold ornaments, no peacock feather
draupadi.costume: Deep red-and-gold silk, palace jewelry, white wedding garland in hand when the beat requires it

drupada.face: Aged Panchala king, noble lined face, dark-grey beard — not Bhishma’s silver diadem, not Drona’s saffron guru
drupada.hair: Grey-black hair, gold royal crown of Panchala
drupada.costume: Indigo-and-gold royal angavastram, no saffron acharya cloth

armies.face: Kings and princes on the hall floor
armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale; women only on balconies behind curtains
